name: ufw-insecure
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: ensures ufw is installed, leaves it DISABLED with a default-allow-incoming policy, and records a rogue backdoor allow rule (port 31337 by default). Paired checks want ufw active+deny and the rogue rule gone. Vars: ROGUE_PORT (optional, default 31337).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
port="${ROGUE_PORT:-31337}"
command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1 || { apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; apt-get install -y ufw >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
ufw --force disable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
ufw default allow incoming >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
ufw allow "$port"/tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
